ingredients.name: evaporated milk, optional for a creamy version

steps.instruction: Heat 2 tablespoons of cooking oil in a pan.
Saute 1 chopped onion and 3 cloves of minced garlic until fragrant.
Add 1 pound of chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned.
Pour in 2 tablespoons of fish sauce and stir for 1 minute.
Add 1 cup of pineapple juice and simmer 15 minutes, until the chicken is tender.
steps.spoken: Add 1 cup of pineapple juice and simmer for 15 to twenty minutes, until the chicken is tender.

steps.instruction: Add 2 chopped carrots and 1 cup of pineapple chunks.
Keep cooking until the vegetables soften.
Pour in 1 cup of evaporated milk to make it creamy, if you like.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Simmer for 3 more minutes, then serve hot.
steps.spoken: Simmer for another 3 to five minutes, then serve hot.
